name: Residents without health insurance
source: Census Reporter API, ACS 2024 1-year table B27001, Monterey County row; underlying estimates are U.S. Census Bureau ACS
notes: ACS table B27001 universe is the civilian noninstitutionalized population. Summing the 14 age-by-sex cells for ages under 65 gives 31,347 people without health insurance out of 353,959 people under 65: 31,347 ÷ 353,959 × 100 = 8.856%, rounded to 8.9%. The denominator and numerator are derived from B27001 cells; the table provides margins of error for each component, but a combined ratio MOE was not calculated, so uncertainty is not propagated for this derived share. This is a 2024 ACS 1-year estimate for GEOID 05000US06053. A separate Census SAHIE 2024 model-based under-65 estimate is 9.3% (MOE 0.8 percentage points), with NUI 32,903 and denominator NIPR 352,397. It uses a different model/population-estimation procedure; comparability of the exact universes has not been established, so it is corroborative context rather than a like-for-like cross-check. SAHIE's original ZIP and extracted row are archived at apps/web/public/evidence/monterey-county/evidence/bcc5435579e66578.bin (SHA-256 5ec0a0cc5cb2e4e17cf046d9f68508decfdb4d9bbb982781d94bbf56ce50347a), but its visual rendering attempt failed in the sandbox. Census Reporter reproduces ACS estimates and is therefore tier 3; the original Census API attempt returned 503.

name: Life expectancy at birth
source: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps 2025 County Health Release, Monterey County, California
notes: The archived CHR 2025 county-layer row for FIPS 06053 reports v147_rawvalue = 80.8471266197383 years. The field description identifies the source as NCHS Natality and Mortality Files plus Census Population Estimates Program and explicitly dates this Monterey value to 2020–2022; year is recorded as the period endpoint 2022. CHR defines the measure as average expected years of life from birth and counts deaths by county of residence: https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/health-data/population-health-and-well-being/length-of-life/life-span/life-expectancy. The exact query and field descriptions appear in the archived source text at apps/web/public/evidence/monterey-county/evidence/7340038b7e846424.txt; raw row JSON is also preserved at apps/web/public/evidence/monterey-county/evidence/37056c673ae97ec8.bin (SHA-256 e03064c1cee2c9e9500b5906f518569999a41a9bbf1a15a116adf1751c7c3136). Readable extract: research/carmel-monterey-2026-10-18/monterey-county/exhibits/chr-2025-monterey-row.csv.
